introH2: 🏖️ What is Ao Nang Beach like, and which zone should you stay in?
introHtml: If one beach is the face of Krabi's coast, it's Ao Nang — a long curve of sand with a beach road lined end to end with seafood restaurants, massage shops, bars, dive centres and tour counters · The reason so many people use Ao Nang as their Krabi base is Ao Nang Pier at the far end of the beach, where longtails and speedboats set off every morning for Talay Waek (the separated sea), Koh Poda, Chicken Island, Railay and Koh Phi Phi — you can be on a boat by breakfast and back in the same neighbourhood by night · But the thing to understand before you book is that Ao Nang has very few genuinely on-the-sand stays. Most sit in the Ao Nang Beach area — a 1- to 10-minute walk from the sand, and some are up on a hill or against the cliffs and rely on a resort shuttle to reach the beach · Book the wrong zone and the whole mood of your trip changes: you wanted to walk onto the sand every morning but ended up on a hill waiting for the next shuttle, or you wanted quiet and landed at a party hostel · This guide gathers 10 Ao Nang Beach-area stays we've reviewed in depth, covering every budget — all built from reading real guest reviews, with the good and the honest caveats spelled out, prices compared across 3 booking sites, and direct links to book
mrtHtml: Krabi has no rail transit — you'll get around by rental car, rental scooter, Grab, or hotel shuttle · Ao Nang Beach is about 25–26 km from Krabi Airport (KBV), roughly a 30–40 minute drive · The zones in this guide: Central Ao Nang Beach — on the beach road or walking street, within walking distance of the sand, the pier and restaurants (Panan, Whalecome, Aonang Cliff, Peace Laguna, Wake Up, Pop-In) · Hillside / deep in a soi — set back from the main road for quiet, with gardens and a natural feel, most with a free beach shuttle (Phu Pha on Soi 13, Vipa ~2 km from the sand) · Up on the hill — clifftop views from above, very quiet, a 4–5 minute shuttle ride down to the sand (Aonang Hill) · Nopparat Thara Beach — the long, quiet beach that runs on from Ao Nang (Ananta Burin) · If your stay has a free beach shuttle, ask for the timetable at check-in so you can plan your days around it

entries.name: Panan Krabi Resort
entries.badge: 🏆 Best score + review base in the set · central location
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Ao Nang · ~5 min walk to the beach · on the walking street
tags: 🏙️ Rooftop infinity pool with limestone views
🚶 Walk to the beach, pier and restaurants
entries.storyHtml: If you want the single best all-rounder in the Ao Nang Beach area, real guest reviews point to Panan Krabi Resort — a boutique 4-star of around 199 rooms set right in the heart of town, about a 5-minute walk to Ao Nang Beach and right by the walking street, restaurants and a 7-Eleven · At 9.1 from 614 reviews, it has both a high score and the largest review base among the 4-star resorts in this set · What guests mention most is the rooftop infinity pool with a bar looking out over the limestone karsts, a rare thing in the middle of Ao Nang, plus a lagoon-style main pool, a kids' pool, and more to do than resorts its size usually offer — a climbing wall and Muay Thai classes — and the breakfast draws praise too · The honest caveats from reviews: the resort sits on the main road, so rooms on the road side or lower floors catch the neighbourhood noise at night, sea views are distant since it's not right on the sand, and room quality isn't perfectly consistent · Best for couples and families who want a central Ao Nang location on a workable budget, with a good-looking pool and plenty to do
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're a light sleeper, ask for an inner room facing the pool or garden and avoid ground-floor rooms by the road · Head up to the rooftop pool at sunset, when the limestone view is at its best · Check whether your rate includes breakfast (the buffet is around ฿450/person), and give the room a once-over at check-in — flag anything off and ask to switch
pros: Central Ao Nang — easy walk to the beach, pier and restaurants
Rooftop infinity pool with limestone views + lagoon pool + kids' pool
More to do than expected — climbing wall, Muay Thai and wellness classes
9.1 from 614 reviews, warm service, praised breakfast
cons: Road-side rooms catch traffic and late-night neighbourhood noise
Not right on the sand — sea views are distant, ~5 min walk to the beach
Room quality isn't consistent; some rooms have older fittings (per reviews)

entries.type: Boutique Resort 3-star · 1-min walk to the beach
entries.name: Whalecome Aonang Resort
entries.badge: 🐋 Highest score in the set · 1-min walk to the beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ao Nang Soi 6 · ~1 min walk to Ao Nang Beach
tags: 🏖️ ~1 min walk to Ao Nang Beach
entries.addr: 926 Moo 2, Aonang Soi 6, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi
entries.storyHtml: A 9.3 — the highest score in this set — at a starting price of about ฿900/night is not a number you see often in the Ao Nang Beach area, and behind it is the simple formula of Whalecome Aonang Resort, a small whale-themed boutique resort on Soi 6 that turns off the main road for less than a minute before the noise drops away · Its number-one selling point is location: reviews say the same thing over and over — it's about a 1-minute walk to Ao Nang Beach, close to restaurants, a 7-Eleven and the pier for island tours · What guests remember is a bed many call the comfiest of their trip, an owner who looks after guests personally, and island tours booked through the resort at better prices than the shopfronts · The honest caveats: it's a small, ageing property — the building and decor are showing their years, there's some rust on the railings, a few reviews mention mosquitoes and insects, and breakfast is simple and occasionally not hot · Best for couples and travellers who want a central Ao Nang base on a light budget, a one-minute walk from the sand, valuing friendly service over polish
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: It's a small property with few rooms, so it fills fast from November to April — book ahead and pick a free-cancellation rate to be safe · Bring your own mosquito repellent and check the window screens close properly · Use the resort's island-tour booking, which reviews confirm beats the shopfront prices, and make the most of the free parking, which is hard to find in Ao Nang
pros: Highest score in the set at 9.3, at the lightest starting price among the resorts
About a 1-minute walk to Ao Nang Beach, near restaurants and the pier
Comfortable beds, owner-run, well-priced island tours (per reviews)
Free parking · free Wi-Fi · friendly, personal service
cons: Building and decor are ageing; some rust on the railings
A few reviews report mosquitoes and insects in rooms or around the resort
Breakfast is simple and limited, and sometimes not served hot

entries.name: Ananta Burin Resort
entries.badge: 🛝 Best family resort in the set · its own water park
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Nopparat Thara–Ao Nang · 5 min walk to the beach
tags: 🏖️ 5 min walk to Nopparat Thara Beach
entries.storyHtml: If you're bringing kids to the sea and want somewhere they can splash all day without leaving, Ananta Burin Resort delivers before you even step off the property — a family 4-star of 111 rooms (SHA Extra Plus) on Nopparat Thara Beach, which runs on from Ao Nang, about a 5-minute walk to the sand · What sets it apart from resorts at similar prices is its own free-to-guests water park: 5- and 8-metre slides, a lazy river, a mock mountain and waterfall, plus two swimming pools, and family rooms in several sizes from Triple to Two-bedroom Fantasy that sleep a crowd. It scores 8.9 from 279 reviews and is one of the best-value family picks in Krabi · The honest caveats: it's lively, with kids' noise around the pools in the daytime, it's not a beachfront resort (you walk out a little to reach the sea), the facilities are solid rather than premium, and breakfast quality can be uneven from day to day · Best for families with children on a modest budget who want their kids to swim to their heart's content near Ao Nang
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Want a quieter night? Ask for a room away from the water-park zone · Hit the water park early or near closing (around 18:00), when it's far less crowded · Travelling as a group? The 82 sqm Two-bedroom Fantasy works out cheaper than booking two rooms · Borrow the resort's free bikes for a ride along Nopparat Thara Beach
pros: Free on-site water park — 5–8 m slides, lazy river; kids swim all day
Several family room types, spacious, with balconies, clean
5 min walk to Nopparat Thara Beach, near shops and restaurants
One of the best-value family picks — 8.9 from 279 reviews
cons: Lively atmosphere with kids' noise around the pools in the daytime
Not a beachfront resort — you walk out a little to reach the sea
Basic facilities; breakfast can be uneven day to day (per reviews)

entries.name: Phu Pha Aonang Resort & Spa
entries.revCount: 8.7 · 1,844 reviews · largest review base in the set
entries.badge: 🌿 Biggest review base at 1,844 · free beach shuttle
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ao Nang Soi 13 (hillside) · free beach shuttle 4×/day
tags: 🌿 Jungle hillside garden, quiet and shaded
entries.addr: 395 Moo 2, Soi 13, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi
entries.storyHtml: Turn off the busy main road of Ao Nang into Soi 13 at the foot of the hill and you'll find a resort that sells the opposite — Phu Pha Aonang Resort & Spa, a 3-star with rooms scattered through a shady tropical garden, limestone cliffs behind them, giving the feeling of an oasis in the jungle even though it's only a few hundred metres from the main strip · At 8.7 from 1,844 reviews — the largest review base in this set — it reflects thousands of guests broadly happy · What people talk about is the quiet garden atmosphere, the garden pool, the spa, and the free beach shuttle to Ao Nang four times a day (11:00, 14:00, 17:00, 19:00) that removes the cost of getting to the sea, plus a halal breakfast buffet that matters to Muslim guests · The honest caveats: it's not a beachfront resort — the beach is a 10–20 minute walk or you wait for a shuttle, some rooms date back to 2010 and are showing their age or feel dark under the tree canopy, and some rooms lack basics like a toothbrush or slippers · Best for couples and families who want a quiet jungle-garden atmosphere on a workable budget, using it as a base for island tours
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Memorise the four shuttle times and plan your activities around them — miss a run and you'll have to arrange your own ride · If room condition matters to you, ask for one renovated in 2023, and if you dislike dark rooms request an upper floor · Bring your own toiletries, and check whether your rate includes breakfast, as paying for it on the day is fairly steep
pros: Quiet, shady jungle-hillside garden with real privacy
Free beach shuttle to Ao Nang 4×/day, saving on transport
Garden pool + kids' pool + spa · good halal breakfast
Largest review base in the set at 1,844, scoring 8.7
cons: Not a beachfront resort — a 10–20 min walk or reliant on the shuttle
Some rooms are ageing; some feel dark under the tree canopy
A few rooms lack basics like a toothbrush or slippers (per reviews)

entries.name: Vipa Tropical Resort
entries.badge: 🌴 Spacious garden bungalows, quiet and calm
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ao Nang (hillside) · ~2 km from the beach · free shuttle
tags: 🌴 Bungalows as roomy as a private house
entries.storyHtml: Some people come to Krabi wanting the opposite of a crowded beachfront hotel — calm, greenery, space and a light price, then a shuttle down to the sand by day · Vipa Tropical Resort is a small bungalow resort of just 17 units tucked into a tropical garden at the foot of the limestone cliffs in the Ao Nang area, scoring 8.9 on Trip.com and 4.5/5 on TripAdvisor · What guests consistently love is how spacious the bungalows are for the price — many describe it as having a little house of their own in a garden — plus family-style friendly service and a quiet pool that stays private because it's never crowded · The caveat to be clear about is the location: the resort is about 2 km from Ao Nang Beach (roughly a 25-minute walk), so you depend on the free beach shuttle that runs several times a day and plan around it. Breakfast is ordinary, some bungalows' furniture is ageing (it opened in 2007), Wi-Fi is slow in spots, and there's no 24-hour front desk · Best for couples and families who value calm, nature and space at a light price over being right on the beach
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for the shuttle timetable at check-in so you can plan your days around it · Travelling as a group? The One/Two-Bedroom Villas are spacious and better value than booking several rooms · Check the room, mattress and linens on arrival — flag anything off; the staff are good about sorting it — and bring a backup mobile data SIM in case the Wi-Fi is slow
pros: Bungalows far roomier than the price suggests — like a private house in a garden
Tropical hillside garden with limestone views, quiet and private
Friendly, genuinely helpful staff · free beach shuttle
8.9 · TripAdvisor 4.5/5, strong value among the small properties
cons: About 2 km from Ao Nang Beach — reliant on the shuttle timetable
Ordinary breakfast · some bungalows' furniture is ageing (opened 2007)
Wi-Fi slow in spots · no 24-hour front desk (per reviews)

entries.name: Aonang Cliff Beach Resort
entries.badge: 🏙️ Rooftop infinity pool over the Andaman
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Ao Nang (on the cliff) · ~5 min walk to the beach
tags: 🏙️ Rooftop infinity pool over the Andaman
📍 Central Ao Nang, 5 min walk to the beach
entries.storyHtml: If your mental image of an Ao Nang holiday is a drink in an infinity pool whose edge seems to spill into the Andaman Sea and the limestone karsts, Aonang Cliff Beach Resort delivers that at a reachable starting price — a 178-room clifftop resort in central Ao Nang, opened in 2008 and later renovated and rebranded as Avani Ao Nang Cliff Krabi Resort · The highlight every review names is the rooftop infinity pool with Andaman Sea views, especially at sunset, plus The Peak rooftop bar and a central location that walks down to the beach, the walking street and the pier in minutes. It scores 8.5 from 173 reviews, with a Booking location score of around 9.4 · The caveat is to choose your room carefully: front rooms facing the road are noisy and the soundproofing isn't great, the layout climbs the cliff so reaching your room or the pool means lifts and several walkways, and it's not a beachfront property — the sand is about a 5-minute walk down · Best for couples and groups who want a central Ao Nang location and a great-looking pool without paying luxury-resort prices
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Head up to the rooftop pool about half an hour before sunset, grab an edge spot and order from The Peak · When booking, ask for a high-floor room on the sea- or mountain-view side and avoid rooms by the road or near the lift for a better night's sleep · If you're less mobile or travelling with elderly guests, request a room near the lift or lobby, as the layout is complex
pros: Stunning rooftop infinity pool over the Andaman, especially at sunset
Central Ao Nang — walk to the beach, the walking street and the pier
Good value given the view and location you get
The Peak rooftop bar + modern renovated rooms (per reviews)
cons: Road-facing rooms are noisy with weak soundproofing — choose carefully
Cliff-climbing layout — reaching your room/pool means several lifts
Not right on the sand — about a 5-minute walk down (per reviews)

entries.name: Peace Laguna Resort & Spa
entries.revCount: 8.4 · 89 reviews · TripAdvisor #16 of 202 Ao Nang hotels · 149 rooms
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Ao Nang · ~200 m (5 min) to the beach
tags: 🌴 Clear lagoon in a tropical garden
🏖️ ~200 m walk to Ao Nang Beach
entries.storyHtml: Open your door in the morning to a clear lagoon with fish in a tropical garden and limestone cliffs behind it, all a few minutes' walk from Ao Nang Beach — that's Peace Laguna Resort & Spa, a garden 4-star of 149 rooms designed with the rooms and cottages wrapped around a central lagoon, making it leafier and quieter than a road-side tower hotel · What guests mention is the three pools that rarely feel crowded, one of them looking out at the limestone karsts, plus the Maya spa and a location about 200 metres' walk to Ao Nang Beach — so you get both the calm of a garden resort and the convenience of the neighbourhood. It scores 8.4 from 89 reviews, with friendly service (staff score around 8.9) and a varied breakfast buffet · The honest caveats: it's a classic garden resort that's been open a while — Wi-Fi is weak in spots, especially in cottages deep in the garden, there are mosquitoes in some seasons, and some fittings in the rooms and around the pools are ageing · Best for families with young children and couples who want a calm, leafy garden atmosphere while still walking to the beach
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The draw here is the garden-and-lagoon setting, so ask for a garden- or lagoon-view room or cottage — it's better value than an inner-facing room · If you need to work online, request a room near the lobby and bring a backup mobile SIM · Pack mosquito spray, since it's a garden resort with lots of greenery and water
pros: Calm, leafy lagoon-in-a-garden setting with limestone views
Three uncrowded pools, one with mountain views · Maya spa
~200 m walk to Ao Nang Beach, friendly service (per reviews)
Rooms and cottages roomier than the price, with private balconies
cons: Wi-Fi weak in spots, especially cottages deep in the garden
Mosquitoes and insects in some seasons
Long-established resort; some fittings in rooms and by pools are ageing (per reviews)

entries.type: Boutique Hill Resort 3-star · SHA Extra Plus
entries.name: Aonang Hill @ 11/1
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ao Nang Soi 11/1 (on the hill) · free beach shuttle every hour
tags: ⛰️ On the hill, cliff views, quiet
entries.addr: 890 Moo 2, Soi 11/1, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi
entries.storyHtml: Krabi isn't only beachfront resorts — some people would rather wake up to limestone cliffs and green mountains than a beach full of people · Aonang Hill @ 11/1 is a small boutique resort on the hill on Soi 11/1, high above the main road, so it's quiet and surrounded by cliff views. It has a pool that looks out at the cliffs and a free beach shuttle to Ao Nang every hour (about a 4–5 minute drive), holds SHA Extra Plus, and was just renovated in 2025 — so rooms are clean and fairly new (its Trip.com cleanliness score is around 9.2) — with everything from a dorm to a villa and a made-to-order breakfast reviews often praise · It scores 9.2 from 41 reviews — a high number, but the review base is still small at just 41, so we've placed it 8th despite the score · The honest caveats: it's not on the sand — the beach is a 4–5 minute shuttle ride, the resort has no bar or evening spot so you head down to the beach zone yourself, and the pool has little shade so it can be hot midday · Best for couples and nature-lovers who want to stay in the Ao Nang area in a quiet hillside setting with cliff views on a workable budget
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Make the most of the hourly free beach shuttle — ask for the timetable at check-in — or rent a scooter if you want more freedom · Not every room has the same open view, so request one facing the cliffs or mountains when booking · Use the pool in the morning or evening, since there's little shade, and plan dinner down in the beach zone as the resort has no evening restaurant
pros: Quiet hilltop with limestone-cliff and green-mountain views all around
Cliff-view pool · clean rooms freshly renovated in 2025
Free beach shuttle to Ao Nang every hour, easy to get around
Varied made-to-order breakfast · rooms from dorm to villa
cons: Small review base of 41, so it sits 8th despite the 9.2 score
Not on the sand — a 4–5 minute shuttle ride to the sea
No bar/evening spot at the resort · pool has little shade (per reviews)

entries.name: Wake Up Aonang Hotel
entries.revCount: 8.6 · 218 reviews · 65 rooms · private rooms and dorms
entries.badge: 💰 Rooms + dorms, central beach, light budget
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Ao Nang Beach · 3–5 min walk to the beach (~390 m)
tags: 📍 3–5 min walk to Ao Nang Beach
🛏️ Both private rooms and good dorms
🏊 Use Krabi Tipa Resort's pool next door
entries.storyHtml: Plenty of people who come to Krabi don't want to sink their money into a five-figure beachfront resort — they just want a clean bed, a light price, a walk to the beach, and their budget saved for island tours · Wake Up Aonang Hotel plays exactly that role — a 3-star flashpacker hotel-meets-hostel of 65 rooms in a soi in the heart of the Ao Nang Beach area, a 3–5 minute walk to the sand (about 390 m) and near the pier for island tours · What sets it apart from ordinary budget stays is that it offers both private rooms and dorm beds with privacy curtains, personal sockets and ensuite bathrooms, plus guests can use the pool at the neighbouring 4-star Krabi Tipa Resort for free, with a massage spa and gym too. Dorm beds start around ฿350/night; it scores 8.6 from 218 reviews · The honest caveats: cleanliness and room condition aren't consistent — some reviews find stains or weak air-con, the pool isn't at the hotel itself but borrowed from the resort next door, service and check-in can be uneven, and there's a stain-fine policy some guests find harsh · Best for budget travellers, backpackers, couples and divers using Krabi as a base for island tours
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Check the room and bathroom the moment you arrive, take photos, and if you find stains or weak air-con ask to switch rooms straight away — and clarify the fine terms · Understand before booking that the pool belongs to Krabi Tipa Resort next door, not the hotel itself · Solo? The dorm is far better value than a private room, and use it as a base for island tours from Ao Nang Pier within walking distance
pros: Central Ao Nang — walk to the beach and the island-tour pier
Light price with both private rooms and ensuite dorm beds
Dorms have privacy curtains and personal sockets, comfy beds
Free use of neighbouring 4-star Krabi Tipa Resort's pool · has a spa
cons: Cleanliness and room condition aren't consistent; some fittings are ageing
The pool isn't at the hotel — it's the resort's next door
Service/check-in can be uneven · a stain-fine policy applies (per reviews)

entries.type: Social Hostel · same team as Pak-Up
entries.name: Pop-In Hostel
entries.revCount: 8.3 · 1,988 reviews · TripAdvisor 4.5/5 · largest review base in the set
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Ao Nang · 10–15 min walk to the beach
tags: 🛏️ Big bunk beds with curtains, large lockers
🚶 10–15 min walk to Ao Nang Beach
entries.storyHtml: Come to Krabi solo, want to sleep in the heart of Ao Nang on a budget, and also want somewhere you can walk downstairs and be chatting with the whole world in one evening — Pop-In Hostel is the name backpackers mention most in the area · It's a social hostel run by the same team as the long-famous Pak-Up Hostel in Krabi Town · Its heart is a big common area, an in-house bar and a BBQ most nights, plus beer pong and giant Jenga that break the ice between strangers, big bunk beds with privacy curtains, large under-bed lockers, and a PADI 5-Star dive centre that runs sea trips in-house. It's a 10–15 minute walk to Ao Nang Beach and scores 8.3 from 1,988 reviews — the largest review base in this set · The honest caveats: this is a party hostel — plenty of reviews call it the loudest in the area outright, there's the call to prayer from the mosque opposite around 5 am, dorm-bed privacy is limited as the curtains don't fully close, and cleanliness is uneven at times · Best for solo travellers and groups of backpackers here to island-hop, meet new people and enjoy the social vibe — not for families or anyone who wants a quiet night
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pack earplugs and an eye mask, because both the evening party atmosphere and the 5 am call to prayer from the mosque are real · Want more privacy? Choose the 4-bed dorm or a private room with an ensuite bathroom · Use the tour desk to book Talay Waek, Koh Phi Phi, Railay and PADI diving, and bring your own drinking water as there isn't always a free refill point on site
pros: Fun social vibe, easy to meet people, BBQ most nights
Central Ao Nang — 10–15 min walk to the beach and restaurants
Big bunk beds with curtains, large lockers, hot showers, fast Wi-Fi
PADI 5-Star dive centre + in-house sea-trip desk
cons: It's a party hostel — loud, not for light sleepers or families
Call to prayer from the mosque opposite around 5 am
Limited dorm-bed privacy · cleanliness uneven at times (per reviews)

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms outside peak season and can change by date and season — always check live prices and compare all 3 sites before booking · The scores and highlights here come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms; we haven't stayed at these properties ourselves · Krabi's high season (November–April) pushes prices up noticeably and small stays like Whalecome, Vipa and Aonang Hill fill first, so plan ahead · Ao Nang has few genuinely on-the-sand stays — most are a 1–10 minute walk to the beach, or up on a hill/hillside with a free beach shuttle (Phu Pha, Vipa, Aonang Hill), so ask for the shuttle timetable at check-in · Krabi has no rail transit — you'll get around by rental car, rental scooter, or Grab · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — common questions about Ao Nang Beach hotels in Krabi

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best Ao Nang Beach hotel?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style and budget · On score alone, Whalecome Aonang Resort at 9.3, a 1-minute walk to the beach, is number one in this set · For the best all-rounder across score, review base and facilities, Panan Krabi Resort at 9.1 (4-star, 614 reviews, rooftop pool) is the most complete pick · For families, Ananta Burin Resort with its own water park · For budget backpackers, Pop-In Hostel at 8.3 from 1,988 reviews

faq.q: ❓ How much do Ao Nang Beach hotels cost?
faq.a: In this guide, from about ฿250–2,800 per night · At the budget end: Pop-In Hostel from ฿250 (dorm bed) and Wake Up Aonang from ฿350 · Mid-range: Whalecome ฿900, Phu Pha ฿1,100, Vipa ฿1,300, Aonang Hill ฿1,400 and Ananta Burin ฿1,500 · Upper end: Aonang Cliff ฿2,000, Peace Laguna ฿2,200 and Panan ฿2,800 · All are approximate starting rates outside peak season; high season (November–April) rises noticeably

faq.q: ❓ What kind of area is Ao Nang, and who is it for?
faq.a: Ao Nang is Krabi's main coastal beach, with a beach road full of seafood restaurants, bars, massage shops and tour counters · The draw is Ao Nang Pier, from which boats leave every morning for Talay Waek, Koh Poda, Chicken Island, Railay and Koh Phi Phi — ideal as an island-hopping base · It suits families, couples and travellers who want to walk to the beach and restaurants · If you want pure quiet on a private beach, Tubkaak, Klong Muang or Railay may suit you better

faq.q: ❓ Which Ao Nang Beach hotel is best for families?
faq.a: The most family-focused is Ananta Burin Resort ฿1,500 — a free on-site water park, 5–8 m slides, a lazy river, 2 pools, and family rooms from Triple to Two-bedroom Fantasy · For a 4-star garden feel with several pools, try Peace Laguna ฿2,200, a lagoon garden with 3 pools including a child-friendly one · For groups or longer stays, look at Vipa Tropical with 2-bedroom bungalows, or Panan with a Family Two-Bedroom Suite and kids' club

faq.q: ❓ Are Ao Nang stays actually on the beach, or a walk away?
faq.a: Honestly, Ao Nang has very few genuinely on-the-sand stays — most are in the area within walking distance · The quickest to the sand is Whalecome (about 1 minute), followed by Wake Up (3–5 min), Panan/Aonang Cliff/Peace Laguna (about 5 min) and Pop-In (10–15 min) · Hillside picks like Phu Pha, Vipa and Aonang Hill are further from the sand but have a free beach shuttle — ask for the timetable at check-in · Ananta Burin is on Nopparat Thara Beach, which runs on from Ao Nang, a 5-minute walk to the sand

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book, and how do I get there?
faq.a: In Krabi's high season (November–April), book 3–6 weeks ahead, especially small stays like Whalecome, Vipa and Aonang Hill that fill first · In low season, 1–2 weeks ahead is fine and prices drop a lot · Getting there: from Krabi Airport (KBV) it's a 30–40 minute drive by taxi, hotel shuttle or Grab · Krabi has no rail transit; around the area people walk, rent a scooter or use Grab · Every platform offers free cancellation, so lock in a rate like that if your plans aren't firm, then compare Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price
